description: Defines data structures, classes, and functions for collecting, resetting, and formatting RLC (Radio Link Control) receive metrics, including mode-specific metrics for TM, UM, and AM modes, with support for external formatting and variant handling.

classes.name: rlc_rx_metrics
classes.description: Main data structure for RLC receive metrics, including mode-specific variants and counters.

classes.name: rlc_rx_metrics_interface
classes.description: Abstract interface class for RLC receive metrics providers.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets all metrics fields to initial state, including mode-specific metrics.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns a copy of current metrics and increments the internal counter.
